limitations: Upstream preprocessing is not verified; a valid record does not establish fold-local fitting.
Public projection omits free-text and open evidence; review the sensitive local record for details.
Aggregate counts and target class names can still be sensitive; this is not formal anonymization.

When tuning is enabled, inner selection uses pooled participant balanced accuracy and protects participants/components; it does not claim held-out-site or held-out-phase inner evaluation. Scores within 1e-12 of the maximum tie; smallest C wins.
Research baseline only; no clinical validity or inferential confidence interval.
Classifier loss weights balance participants; imputation and scaling use training-observation statistics.
A failed fold prevents a pooled complete-CV score; undefined metrics retain null reasons.
